title: : FULL RESTORATION AND RECOVERY
verse: region) shall not overpower.” (Amp) Matt 16:18
body: : FULL RESTORATION AND RECOVERY “. the gates of Hades (the powers of the infernal region) shall not overpower.” (Amp) Matt 16:18 Forces of darkness are real. They’re constantly wagging wars against marriages - causing division - they want marriages to fail! You must learn to resist and frustrate all their activities from the pit of hell against your home unrelentingly - rendering their plans against your marriage null and void. “. Your adversary the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.” (WEB) 1Pet 5:8-9. Stop fighting your children or spouse when things go wrong - fight the unseen forces [fight the devil and his cohorts], Jam 4:7. Winning in warfare is never worrisome. It could only be worrisome when there is no submission to God’s order. Submit to God and His Word, resist the devil and he will not only flee, he will flee with all his properties. And you will experience heaven on earth in your marriage, Ps 24:7-8.
prayer: 1. Thank God for your marriage 2. Switch over to warfare prayer - come against every spirit working against your home - anti-peace, antiprogress, anti-success and the like 3. Release the hand of God against every force, power and principality contending against your home.

title: : CONTENDING WITH HELL OVER YOUR MARRIAGE 1
verse: region) shall not overpower.” (AMP) Matt 16:18
body: : CONTENDING WITH HELL OVER YOUR MARRIAGE 1 “. the gates of Hades (the powers of the infernal region) shall not overpower.” (AMP) Matt 16:18 In his introduction to The Screwtape Letters, C. S. Lewis made this striking assertion, “There are two equal and opposite errors into which our race can fall about the devils. One is to disbelieve in their existence. The other is to believe, and to feel an excessive and unhealthy interest in them. They themselves are equally pleased by both errors.” The devil hates marriage because he hates God and His loving plan for the human race [Gen 2:18]. Paul said, “For we are not wrestling with flesh and blood [contending only with physical opponents], but against the despotisms, against the powers, against [the master spirits who are] the world rulers of this present darkness, against the spirit forces of wickedness in the heavenly (supernatural) sphere. Therefore put on God's complete armor.” (AMP) Eph 6:12-13. Get yourself armed! Fight to finish!
prayer: 1. Bind the powers and principalities instigating discord, disagreement, bitterness, delay and all kinds of affliction 2. Render the power of darkness over your marriage impotent 3. Redeem your marriage.

title: : CONTENDING WITH HELL OVER YOUR MARRIAGE 2
verse: soul.” (KJV) 2 Kings 23:25
body: : CONTENDING WITH HELL OVER YOUR MARRIAGE 2 “. like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul.” (KJV) 2 Kings 23:25 Our hearts like a container - cannot be left empty - it’s either filled with love for God or something else will fill it up. Jesus declares, “And you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength” (ESV). What a command! Our whole being must be filled [to overflow] with love for God. TBCL says, “So love the Lord God with all your passion and prayer and intelligence and energy.” (Mark 12:30). So amazing, you can love Him passionately! The Amplified says, “And you shall love the Lord your God out of and with your whole heart and out of and with all your soul (your life) and out of and with all your mind (with your faculty of thought and your moral understanding) and out of and with all your strength.” Love everyone and help everyone.
prayer: 1. Confess your past negligence, promise God you’re ready to love Him more passionately 2. Ask God to set your heart on fire for Him 3. Pray against those things affecting your love for Him 4. Commit your activities into God’s hands.

title: : FILL OUR HEAR TS WITH THY LOVE
verse: Lord.” (NKJV) Micah 3:8
body: : FILL OUR HEAR TS WITH THY LOVE “But truly I am full of power by the Spirit of the Lord.” (NKJV) Micah 3:8 You need more than natural ability - you need God-kind of ability - to declare the Word with audacity and all authority. “But you shall receive power (ability, efficiency, and might) when the Holy Spirit has come upon you.” (Amp) Acts 1:8. This is what you need to turn timidity to fearlessness in the face of opposition. “And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes, And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest. [These were men of no small means and pedigree, don’t forget]. they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?” Ordinary Peter couldn’t have spoken this way - it was the supernatural that took over the natural. Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled. [It is not limited to the days of the Apostles]. and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus” (KJV) Acts 4:5-13. Tarry, Luke 24:49.
prayer: Father, fill me up till I want no more. Let Your power rest so strongly on me, Amen.

title: : POWER FROM ON HIGH
verse: they shall revive as the corn.” (KJV) Hosea 14:7
body: : POWER FROM ON HIGH “They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn.” (KJV) Hosea 14:7 Among many indices of true revival is holy living - living by His Word. “All has been heard; the end of the matter is: Fear God [revere and worship Him.] keep His commandments, for this is the whole of man [the full, original purpose of his creation, the object of God's providence, the root of character, the foundation of all happiness, the adjustment to all inharmonious circumstances and conditions under the sun] and the whole [duty] for every man. For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it is good or evil” (Amp) Ecc 12:13-14. Where there is a true revival, there will be a true holy living - no pretence, no deception. “Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an ensample to them that believe, in word, in manner of life, in love, in faith, in purity. ” (ASV) 1 Tim 4:12.
confession: I am a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a dedicated nation, [God's] own purchased, special being, that I may show forth the wonderful deeds and display the virtues and perfections of Him Who called me out of darkness into His marvelous light.

title: : INDICES OF TRUE REVIVAL 1
verse: they shall revive as the corn.” (KJV) Hosea 14:7
body: : INDICES OF TRUE REVIVAL 1 “They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn.” (KJV) Hosea 14:7 In the midst of true revival is the spirit of prayer and supplication. For so is the experience at every root of revival. Sadhu Sundar Singh said, “The essence of prayer does not consist in asking God for something but in opening our hearts to God, in speaking with Him, and living with Him in perpetual communion. Prayer is continual abandonment to God. Prayer does not mean asking God for all kinds of things we want; it is rather the desire for God Himself.” Be a prayer winner, not just a prayer warrior! Eliezer [Gen 24:12] was a man of prayer and so was Jacob [Gen 32:9-12], Gideon [Judg 6:22, 36, 39], Hannah [1 Sam 1:10], Hezekiah [2 Ki 20:2 ], Isaiah [2 Ki 20:11], Manasseh [2 Ch 33:18; 2 Ch 33:19], Ezra [Ezra 9:5; Ezra 9:6], Nehemiah [Neh 2:4], Daniel [Dan 9:3; Dan 9:19 ], Anna [Luke 2:37] and even Jesus [Mat 14:23]. Queen of Scots said “I fear the prayers of John Knox more than all the assembled armies of Europe.” With a praying life you enjoy a prevailing life.
prayer: Jesus, I decree an uncommon anointing upon my life to live a praying life, Amen.

title: : INDICES OF TRUE REVIVAL 2
verse: they shall revive as the corn.” (KJV) Hosea 14:7
body: : INDICES OF TRUE REVIVAL 2 “They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn.” (KJV) Hosea 14:7 It was said of John Smith, one of the most anointed men and the spiritual father, that “he ceased to estimate all preaching, and indeed all ministerial labor except as it produced saving effects.” ‘A minister of the Gospel is sent to turn men from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan to God!' Turning men from darkness to light is the major assignment committed into the hands of every child of God. That’s is the spirit of true revival! That’s an index of personal encounter with God! “The spirit of Christ is the spirit of missions” said Henry Martyn “The nearer we get to Him, the more intensely missionary we become.” Evangelism - aggressive and radical evangelism - is the very heartbeat of the Father. “The evangelistic harvest is always urgent. The destiny of men and of nations is always being decided. Every generation is strategic.” said Billy Graham. All hands must be on deck to see the gospel spread in our time. We can no longer fold our hands. The task must be done.
confession: I will do the work of an evangelist - every where I go - leading men to light.

title: : INDICES OF TRUE REVIVAL 3
verse: sins may be blotted out.” (KJV) Acts 3:19
body: : INDICES OF TRUE REVIVAL 3 “Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out.” (KJV) Acts 3:19 Paul said, “And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men” (KJV) Acts 24:16. Restitution is so essential to a life of righteousness. If you’ve gotten something deceitfully, by false accusation, or you’ve taken something by theft or extortion, or suppose you find a lost item and lie about it, then confess it to God, apologize to the owner, and return the stolen items. Restitution is as simple as that! “If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the LORD, and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour; Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein.” Lev 6:2-5. [Read Lev 24:18; 1 Sam 12:3; Ezek 33:15; Acts 23:1 and 2 Cor 5:10].
prayer: Thank You for the insight, dear Father. Everything wrongly acquired, I’m restoring them in Jesus precious name, Amen. [Plan to restore to the rightful owners those things or properties that are not yours this very week.]

title: : REPENTANCE AND RESTITUTION
body: : REPENTANCE AND RESTITUTION

title: : HEARTFELT CRY FOR RIGHTEOUSNESS
verse: way straight before my face?” (KJV) Ps 5:8
body: : HEARTFELT CRY FOR RIGHTEOUSNESS “Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness. make thy way straight before my face?” (KJV) Ps 5:8 Back in 1897, Thomas O. Chisholm wrote, “1. Oh! to be like Thee, blessed Redeemer, This is my constant longing and prayer; Gladly I'll forfeit all of earth's treasures, Jesus, Thy perfect likeness to wear. Oh! to be like Thee, oh! to be like Thee, Blessed Redeemer, pure as Thou art; Come in Thy sweetness, come in Thy fullness; Stamp Thine own image deep on my heart. 2. Oh! to be like Thee, lowly in spirit, Holy and harmless, patient and brave; Meekly enduring cruel reproaches, Willing to suffer, others to save. 3. Oh! to be like Thee, while I am pleading, Pour out Thy Spirit, fill with Thy love, Make me a temple meet for Thy dwelling, Fit me for life and Heaven above.” Righteousness is the cry need of our time. God wants to see it exalted in the body of Christ. Jesus died for it. The Holy Spirit is sent for our right-thinking, right-standing and rightliving - for these are righteousness summarized.
confession: 'Lord, I want to be like Jesus in my heart, in my heart, Lord, I want to be like Jesus in my heart, in my heart. In my heart, in my heart, Lord, I want to be like Jesus in my heart, in my heart.’ “O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come” (KJV) Ps 65:2 “God's cause is committed to men; God commits Himself to men. Praying men are the vice-regents of God; they do His work and carry out His plans.” said E. M. Bounds. Prayer is the key. Through it, there is no dry ground that can't be flooded, no burden that can't be lighten, no broken relationship that can't be mended, no poverty cycle that can't be broken, no perishing that can't be rescued. No hurt that can't be erased, no hindrance that can't be taken out of the way, no limitation that can't be overcome, no mountain that can’t be moved, no desert that can't blossom, no congregation that can't be revived and no nation that can't be transformed. Mary Warburton Booth prayed: “Oh! for a heart that is burdened! Infused with a passion to pray; Oh! For a stirring within me' Oh! For His power every day, Oh! For a heart like my Saviour.” [Read Jer 33:3].

title: 1: HEARTFELT CRY FOR REVIVAL OF PRAYER
verse: ever quit. Just keep it simple” (TBCL) 2 Tim 4:2
body: 1: HEARTFELT CRY FOR REVIVAL OF PRA YER “So proclaim the Message with intensity. Don't ever quit. Just keep it simple” (TBCL) 2 Tim 4:2 “Herald and preach the Word! Keep your sense of urgency [stand by, be at hand and ready], whether the opportunity seems to be favorable or unfavorable. [Whether it is convenient or inconvenient, whether it is welcome or unwelcome, you as preacher of the Word are to show people in what way their lives are wrong.] And convince them, rebuking and correcting, warning and urging and encouraging them, being unflagging and inexhaustible in patience and teaching.” So clear! Take every advantage to proclaim the gospel. Archibald Brown says, “The Gospel is a fact; therefore tell it simply. The Gospel is a joyful fact; therefore tell it cheerfully. The Gospel is an entrusted fact; therefore tell it faithfully. The Gospel is a fact of infinite moment; therefore tell it earnestly. The Gospel is a fact of infinite love; therefore tell in feelingly. The Gospel is a fact of difficult comprehension to many; therefore tell it with illustration. The Gospel is a fact about a Person; therefore preach Christ.”
confession: I take it upon myself to always take every advantage to herald the gospel.

title: : GOSPEL PROCLAMATION AND PROPAGATION
verse: years.” (KJV) Hab 3:2
body: : GOSPEL PROCLAMATION AND PROPAGATION “. O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years.” (KJV) Hab 3:2 Does it grieve you that we live in such a godless age where righteousness and moral ethics have no value? “O Lord, I have heard of what you have done, and I am filled with awe. Now do again in our times the great deeds you used to do. Be merciful, even when you are angry” (GNT). That God might give us the old-time revival should be our earnest prayer. “Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence” (KJV) Isa 64:1. It’s time to seek His face. Spend quality time on each of the underlined Psalmist’s prayers below and trust God for His mercy. “Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants. O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days. Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.” (KJV) Ps 90:13-17.
confession: 1. Father, revive thy work in the midst of the year 2. Do among us what you did among the saints of old and work among us 3. Pray and cry for end-time revival.

title: : REVIVE THY WORK
verse: hand shall save me” (KJV) Ps 138:7
body: : REVIVE THY WORK “Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me” (KJV) Ps 138:7 Del Fehsenfeld Jr. must be right, “Revival awakens in our hearts an increased awareness of the presence of God, a new love for God, a new hatred for sin, and a hunger for His Word.” Revival is needed when sin is being committed at will and our hearts no longer prick us. “. Shall we continue in sin that grace may abound?” (NKJV) Rom 6:1. Revival is needed when there is lukewarmness. “. since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out.” (CEV) Rev 3:16. Revival is needed when backsliding and careless living become the order of the day. “Turn, O backsliding children.” (KJV) Jer 3:14. Revival is needed when prayerlessness is the order of the day and the zeal for agonizing prayer is lost. “. men always ought to pray and not lose heart” (NKJV) Luke 18:1. Revival is needed when passion for soul-winning is lost and evangelism has become mechanical, Jonah 1:1-3.
confession: Sing it! Hum it! Pray it! Revival must come [3 times], to the glory of the Lord. Pray as led.

title: : REVIVAL IS NEEDED WHEN
verse: his chosen Messiah” (CEV) Acts 3:19-20
body: : REVIVAL IS NEEDED WHEN “So turn to God! Give up your sins, and you will be forgiven. Then that time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah” (CEV) Acts 3:19-20 “There shall be showers of blessing: This is the promise of love; There shall be seasons refreshing, Sent from the Savior above. Showers of blessing, Showers of blessing we need: Mercy-drops round us are falling, But for the showers we plead. There shall be showers of blessing, Precious reviving again; Over the hills and the valleys, Sound of abundance of rain. There shall be showers of blessing, If we but trust and obey; There shall be seasons refreshing, If we let God have His way.” sang Daniel Whittle. To daily experience the best of God, we must always give Him the best of our time in quality devotion. “So repent (change your mind and purpose); turn around and return [to God], that your sins may be erased.”
prayer: Dear Father, send a revival among us. Give us - time of refreshing - like of old, help us that we might turn from our sins. Kindle your fire in us that we might draw near to Your throne. Revive us again, O Lord. Send Your mighty revival. And let it begin with me in Jesus mighty name, Amen.

title: : TIME OF REFRESHING
verse: seek the LORD.” (KJV) Hos 10:12
body: : TIME OF REFRESHING “. break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD.” (KJV) Hos 10:12 “. Break up your fallow ground. Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, remove the foreskin of your hearts.” (RSV) Jer 4:3-4. It's hard and difficult for seeds to grow in an unplowed ground - stumps must be removed, hardness must be broken up, larger clods and rocks must be dealt with and thorns must be gathered and burned for plants to thrive. What is it that is growing in the soil of your heart lately? Unforgiveness, hatred or fleshly desires? They must be rooted out so as to allow God’s Word to thrive. You see, when a field is not planted for several years, it often covered with thorns and other weeds. The question is: what kinds of thorns make the fields of your hearts unproductive? These thorns could be pride and arrogance, anger and animosity, selfishness and self-centreness, addictions and others. The truth is, each of these has a devastating effect on the kind of crop that God wants to grow in your heart. God wants us all to "break up" our fallow ground so that it becomes better usable, Pro 11:18.
prayer: Father, I open up my heart for a fresh dealing of the Holy Spirit in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : BREAK UP YOUR FALLOW GROUND
verse: walk in the fear of our God?” (ASV) Neh 5:9
body: : BREAK UP YOUR FALLOW GROUND “. The thing that ye do is not good: ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God?” (ASV) Neh 5:9 Right from the ageless past, God had wanted a consistent walk-partner. Someone for companionship, intimacy, joint decision-making and shared dominion. God longs to walk with you. You know what? God’s great goal for you is an everyday walk of unbroken communion. Enoch had a consistent walk with Him. “. Enoch walked with God, and he was not, for God took him” (WEB) Gen 5:22-24. Desist from rising and falling. Be determined! Be resolute! And work on yourself. Walking with Him brings us to a realm where God unfolds the secrets of His kingdom to us. The patriarchs of faith followed this path and were used of God. Noah, through his walk with God, got his life and that of his generation preserved [Gen 6:9], and so did Abraham [Gen 24:40]. You can experience a greater degree of the kingdom mystery.
prayer: The Eternal Rock of Ages, I stand against the works of darkness and I reject the spirit of rising and falling in my walk with You. I receive spiritual strength to walk with You consistently. No more weakness of the spirit in the name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : DESIST FROM RISING AND  FALLING
verse: “. in thy presence is fulness of joy” (KJV) Ps 16:11
body: : DESIST FROM RISING AND FALLING “. in thy presence is fulness of joy” (KJV) Ps 16:11 Nothing on earth is as sweet and satisfying like His presence. In His presence is the F-U-L-L-N-E-S-S [richness and abundance] of J-O-Y. How refreshing to sing, “I just want to be where You are, dwelling daily in Your presence, I don't want to worship from afar, draw me near to where You are. I just want to be where You are, in Your dwelling place forever, Take me to the place where You are, I just want to be with You. I just want to be where You are, to enter boldly in Your presence, I don't want to worship from afar, draw me near to where You are. I want to be where You are, dwelling in Your presence, feasting at Your table, surrounded by Your glory, In Your presence, that's where I always want to be, I just want to be, I just want to be with You. Oh, my God, You are my strength and my song, And when I'm in Your presence, Though I'm weak You're always strong. I just want to be, I just want to be with You.” Make this commitment! “As for me, I will continue beholding Your face in righteousness.” Ps 17:15; Eph 4:30-31.
prayer: Dear Lord, I ask for divine help to maintain my walk with You in Jesus precious name, Amen.

title: : IN HIS PRESENCE
verse: but alive to God in Christ.” (NKJV) Rom 6:11
body: : IN HIS PRESENCE “. reckon yourselves to be dead indeed to sin, but alive to God in Christ.” (NKJV) Rom 6:11 Dead in reference to sin is in the sense of putting sin away - setting it aside and laying it down - from you, and having nothing to do with it. The Bible commands you to be alive unto God; living a new life of holiness - devoted to God's glory, in imitation of Christ's resurrec tion-life. Verses 12-16 reads, “Therefore, never let sin rule your physical body so that you obey its desires. Never offer any part of your body to sin's power. No part of your body should ever be used to do any ungodly thing.” (GWT). Living in the light of our union with Christ is the key to being alive to God. Walking in the consciousness of Christ’s presence. “Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection.” (KJV) Col 3:5. The word mortify is from Greek nekroo meaning subdue. You can always be alive to God by learning to say NO to sin.
prayer: Sweet Holy Spirit, thank You for sending Your Word to me today. I pray just as the Bible commands, never to offer any part of my body to sin’s power in the precious name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : RECKON YOURSELF DEAD TO SIN
verse: and supplications, with fasting.” (ASV) Dan 9:3
body: : RECKON YOURSELF DEAD TO SIN “. I set my face unto the Lord. to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting.” (ASV) Dan 9:3 Fasting and prayers are great spiritual weapons. “. this kind goeth not out, but by prayer and fasting” (NWB) Matt 17:21. Fasting ushers in a great revival and harvest of souls from around the world. “If my people who are called by my name humble themselves, and pray and seek my face. then I will hear from heaven and will forgive their sin and heal their land” (ESV) 2 Chro 7:14]. Before God could come in His mighty revival, we’ve to heed His call to wait and wail so as to win with Him. “Therefore also now, saith the Lord, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning: And rend your heart, and not your garments.” (KJV) Joel 2:12-13. When last did you turn to the Lord in seeking His face? When last did you truly fast in the real sense of fasting and praying? When last did you turn to the Lord your God to renew your strength in Him? There is power in fasting, Isa 40:31.
prayer: Dear heavenly Father, I receive the power to be disciplined in the exercise of fasting and praying. I pray that Your Spirit guide me as I set a specific time for it in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : SPIRITUAL EXERCISE OF FASTING
verse: he will raise us up.” (RSV) Hos 6:2
body: : SPIRITUAL EXERCISE OF FASTING “After two days he will revive us; on the third day he will raise us up.” (RSV) Hos 6:2 In the battlefields of most spiritual service, true heroes are mostly unseen by the world. These are the ones who touched heaven on their knees, moved the hand that moved the world and shook the foundation of hell. Such was Father Nash, a fellow partner to the famous evangelist Charles Finney. Nash would go quietly into town 2 to 3 weeks before the Finney’s meeting. Sometimes he would go with Abel Clary, a man of similar praying ministry - praying for the convicting power of the Holy Spirit to fall on the crowd and melt hearts of men. One day, a group of young men wanted to break up the meeting. Nash came out to announce: “Now mark me, young men! God will break your ranks in less than one week.” By Tuesday morning, the leader of the group confessed his sinful attitude. “What shall I do Mr. Finney?” he asked. Before that week was ended, nearly all group members had come to Christ. In Nash’s heart dwelt the burning Spirit of God. We can’t do any less - we must burn with such passion to see God's Kingdom advanced.
prayer: Lord, Pour upon me, the Spirit of prayer.

title: : REVIVALIST 1
verse: he will raise us up.” (RSV) Hos 6:2
body: : REVIVALIST 1 “After two days he will revive us; on the third day he will raise us up.” (RSV) Hos 6:2 Born in Massachusetts, February 5, 1837. D. L. Moody was one of the greatest evangelists of all time. In a 40-year period he had won a million souls, launched a great Christian publishing company, founded three Christian schools, established a world-renowned Christian centre and inspired thousands of preachers to win souls and conduct revivals around the world. How did he manifest God’s power in his life? He was truly surrendered - nothing in between - everything he was and everything he had, belonged wholly to God. He was far greater a man of a pray-er than a preacher. He was a student of the Bible. Rising about four o'clock in the morning to study the Word. He drew immense crowds because of his thorough knowledge of the Bible. Besides, he was free from the love of money and had a consuming passion for the lost. He made the resolution never to let twenty-four hours pass without speaking to the lost. Above all, he was endued with power.
prayer: 1. Pray the prayer of commitment and consecration 2. Take each of the points in today’s study to God in prayer and pray through.

title: : REVIVALIST 2
verse: he will raise us up.” (RSV) Hos 6:2
body: : REVIVALIST 2 “After two days he will revive us; on the third day he will raise us up.” (RSV) Hos 6:2 Here is an amazing story of how hundreds of thousands souls were converted through one man's ministry. In an age without modern technology - no amplifiers and no microphones - 19th century evangelist Charles G. Finney's ministry changed the course of American Christianity. In the fall of 1821, he began to seek the Lord. After his conversion, he began to preach from coast to coast. The power of God on Finney’s work was mighty that the entire business district was shut down to attend his meetings. Great crowds followed Finney as he preached from place to place. At a time when most pastors read their sermons, Finney preached without notes - and without prior preparation. He was a man of intense prayer. Anointing and unction of the Holy Spirit rested on him so heavily. Whenever he ministered the Word, people would often fall into silence. Then they would come under a prolonged and piercing sense of their sin and many turned to Christ. Finney gave himself extravagantly for the redemption of the lost.
prayer: Dear Holy Spirit, set me on fire, Amen.

title: : REVIVALIST 3
verse: those whom He was saving” (WNT) Acts 2:47
body: : REVIVALIST 3 “. day by day, the Lord added to their number those whom He was saving” (WNT) Acts 2:47 “And believers were the more added to the Lord. Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them. There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one” (KJV) Acts 5:14-16. Church growth is God’s extraordinary goal. Church growth in the early Church was based on those who were saved. And this must be our concept as individuals. True growth is not about adding to the number but about adding to the kingdom. “The days in which we live are days of great opportunity and of grave responsibility, and a second-hand religion is not good enough for times such as these. They demand that we should always be at our best if we are to seize our opportunities and manfully shoulder our responsibilities” - J. A. Broadbelt.
prayer: Father, help your Church to grow in grace and power in the name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : REVIVAL AND CHURCH GROWTH
body: : REVIVAL AND CHURCH GROWTH

title: : AND THE WORD OF GOD INCREASED
verse: disciples multiplied.” (KJV) Acts 6:7
body: : AND THE WORD OF GOD INCREASED “. the word of God increased. the number of the disciples multiplied.” (KJV) Acts 6:7 Acts 12:24 says, “Meanwhile, the ministry of God's Word grew by leaps and bounds” (TBCL). You need the Word to succeed either as an individual, ministry or even as a nation. Here are the impacts of the Word: 1. The Word builds. “. I commend you to God and to the word of His grace, which is able to build you up and give you an inheritance among all those who are sanctified” (NKJV) Acts 20:32. That's it! It builds and gives you your divine inheritance. 2. The Word renews. “And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge.” (KJV) Col 3:10. A daily intake of the Word renews your spirit and brings you to the realm of God's perfect image. 3. The Word prospers. It waters you and keeps you within the orbit of bliss and breakthrough beyond bounds, Ps 1:2-3. 4. The Word purifies. The Word does to our spirit what the water does to the body. It cleanses and makes thoroughly clean, Eph 5:26.
confession: I accept the transformative power of the Word. I am giving adequate attention to the Word - studying it, meditating on it and living it out. By His limitless grace, I grow in and with the Word.

title: : PATHWAY TO REVIVAL
verse: commandment” (KJV) 2 Chro 14:2-4
body: : PATHWAY TO REVIVAL “And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God: For he took away the altars of the strange gods, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves: And commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment” (KJV) 2 Chro 14:2-4 Henry Varley, a very intimate friend of D. L. Moody in the earlier days of his ministry once said: “It remains to be seen what God will do with a man who gives himself up wholly to Him.” When Mr. Henry Varley said that, Mr. Moody said to himself: “Well, I will be that man.” Moody went right ahead to touch more than two continents for God. The Record of Christian Work dated October 1908 made this assertion, “Today comes but once, and comes never to return. We hope it will come again tomorrow; but it does not. It is gone forever, with its inexhaustible possibilities, privileges and responsibilities.” Don't forget to present your body as a living sacrifice, Rom 12:1. Live a life totally committed to knowing Him more. This's what Christianity is all about. This's what you must do!
prayer: Thank You for Your Word. I will live out the Word. [Spend time in seeking His face today.] “. can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest” (KJV) Ezek 37:3 God has A-L-L the power to do A-L-L things. “Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?” (KJV) John 11:25-26. Dry bones could represent spiritual dryness, physical deadness or psychological sickness. By all human laws, Ezekiel knew it would be impossible for these bones to live. But he answered, thou knowest. His answer admits the powerlessness of man, while acknowledging God’s supernatural ability both to resurrect and restore to full life. “Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you.” (KJV) Eze 37:5. No matter the condition - You can experience real life again - in your body, finance, marriage and in all areas, Luke 1:45. God brings back to life and vitality.

title: : CAN THESE BONES LIVE?
verse: stir up the gift of God.” (KJV) 2 Tim 1:6
body: : CAN THESE BONES LIVE? “Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God.” (KJV) 2 Tim 1:6 God won’t do for you what you can do for yourself. If fire, for instance, is not frequently stirred up, and fresh fuel added to it, it can go out. This is the precise picture which the apostle had in mind when he gave the charge to ‘stir up the gift.’ The idea is that Timothy was to use all possible spiritual means to keep the flame of God-special grace and unction upon him burning brightly, brilliantly and vibrantly. No matter how excellent the gifts we are endowed with are, they do not flourish on their own accord, they’ve to be nurtured - developed and fired up - to produce maximum benefits. “Do not neglect the gift which is in you, [that special inward endowment] which was directly imparted to you [by the Holy Spirit] by prophetic utterance when the elders laid their hands upon you [at your ordination]” (Amp) 1 Tim 4:14. Every gift gets better with use, Rom 12:6-8.
prayer: Father, I keep away all spiritual coldness and dormancy, I commit myself to stirring up the gifts of God in me. I take it upon myself to revive the spark of the flame and never to quench the Spirit in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : STIR UP THE GIFT OF GOD
verse: therein.” (KJV) Ezek 20:47-48
body: : STIR UP THE GIFT OF GOD “. I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.” (KJV) Ezek 20:47-48 Early in the Welsh Revival (1904), a Wiltshire evangelist visited the meetings at Ferndale. He stood up and said, “Friends, I have journeyed into Wales with the hope that I may glean the secret of the Welsh Revival.” In a moment, Evan Roberts was on his feet, and with an uplifted arm towards the speaker he replied, “My brother, there is no secret! Ask and ye shall receive!” Fire makes the difference between the weak and the strong and the talking and the doing Christians. “Then I said, "I will not make mention of Him, Nor speak anymore in His name." But His word was in my heart like a burning fire shut up in my bones; I was weary of holding it back, And I could not” (NKJV) Jer 20:9. Fire fuels the unction! With all thine getting, get the fire! And keep it burning! “The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar.” (KJV) Lev 6:13.
prayer: I pray for the fire of the Holy Ghost - in a torrential manner - to set me on the GO for You. Keep me on the firing line in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : FIRE IN THE BONES
verse: which must be hereafter” (KJV) Rev 4:1
body: : FIRE IN THE BONES “. Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter” (KJV) Rev 4:1 “And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off” (KJV) Exo 24:1. God wants you to reach out for new heights in Him. He loves to introduce you to new realms and new dimensions in the school of the Holy Spirit. “But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength. They shall mount up with wings like eagles; they shall run and not be weary; they shall walk and not faint” (TLB) Isa 40:31. He needs you - you are important in His agenda for this age. His heartfelt desire is to take you to new levels of intimacy. He wants you to do much more for Him and His kingdom. In going up higher, you experience a deeper cleansing, fellowship and His voice becomes clearer and distinct. In this realm, you find new doors of spiritual insight, gain new spiritual power and authority, and develop new levels of communication line with God.
confession: My heart has no desire to stay, where doubts arise and fears dismay; though some may dwell where these abound, my prayer, my aim, is higher ground.

title: : COME UP HIGHER
verse: creeps upon the earth” (AMP) Gen 1:26
body: : COME UP HIGHER “God said, Let Us [Father, Son, and Holy Spirit] make mankind in Our image, after Our likeness, and let them have complete authority over the fish of the sea, the birds of the air, the [tame] beasts, and over all of the earth, and over everything that creeps upon the earth” (AMP) Gen 1:26 You must study to understand God’s purpose for your creation. It’s then you can pursue your assignment from a truly biblical viewpoint. Our lives can’t find true inner serenity more than our understanding of His original intent for our creation. “Then God said, "Let us make a man - someone like ourselves, to be the master of all life upon the earth and in the skies and in the seas” (TLB) Gen 1:26. Author Richard Pratt in Designed for Dignity said, “God ordained humanity to be the primary instrument by which his kingship will be realized on earth.” He said, “The Great King has summoned each of us into his throne room. Take this portion of my kingdom, he says. Put your heart into mastering this part of my world. Get it in order; unearth its treasures; do all you can with it.
prayer: Almighty God, thank You for sending such an amazing truth to me. Lord, I am taking my place in destiny in Jesus precious name, Amen.
